body: Workaround for every TermAl lane, from 2026-10-29 01:15Z until Engram w-b1ae95ab86d7 is fixed. An Engram write (note, gate, claim or update) that returns `busy_budget_exhausted` (SQLite begin_immediate, acquisition_not_started) MAY HAVE COMMITTED. READ BACK first, with `show … notes` or the matching read, and retry only if the record is absent. Never blind-retry: that writes duplicates. Evidence: Merger2's carrier note c9e4b719d46b4b0fa89a493d6ea69025 persisted at 01:11:04Z although the tool reported the busy error (Merger2 891850c6 #917/#918). Filed by Engram::Fable as Engram w-b1ae95ab86d7 (P1), ebe242f7 #5185.
